# A malformed url-encoded body causes ParseForm to return an error; the
# generated handler responds 400 Bad Request with http.Error and returns
# before calling the receiver method.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
muxt check

exec go test -cover

-- template.gohtml --
{{define "POST /login 201 Login(form)" }}<p>hi {{.Result}}</p>{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"net/url"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type T struct{}

func (T) Login(form url.Values) string { return form.Get("username") }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestFormParseError(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, T{})

	t.Run("a malformed body responds 400", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/login", strings.NewReader("username=%zz"))
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
			t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusBadRequest)
		}
		if body := rec.Body.String(); !strings.Contains(body, "invalid URL escape") || strings.Contains(body, "<p>") {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want the plain http.Error text, not a rendered template", body)
		}
	})

	t.Run("a well-formed body responds 201", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/login", strings.NewReader("username=ada"))
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if rec.Code != http.StatusCreated {
			t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusCreated)
		}
		if !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), "<p>hi ada</p>") {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want the greeting", rec.Body.String())
		}
	})
}
